nodes.rationale: Clean-room, local-first desktop PDF editor in Rust with egui/eframe and PDFium; no account, telemetry, or cloud required; GPL-3.0.

nodes.label: macOS quarantine / codesign fix
nodes.rationale: Downloaded dylib carries com.apple.quarantine and ad-hoc signature breaks on repackaging, so dlopen fails; fix with xattr -d and codesign.

nodes.label: AI off-by-default privacy model
nodes.rationale: API keys live in OS keyring, never a config file; document text sent only on button press; no provider/network connection created while AI switch is off.

nodes.label: Four-crate workspace architecture
nodes.rationale: Four workspace crates, no server and no database.

nodes.label: Agent C1 — Read-Aloud / TTS
nodes.rationale: New capture/tts.rs (~40 LoC): TtsEngine wraps Option<Child>, shells out to macOS say, parses `say -v ?` for voices, -r for speed (default 175 wpm, 100-300). Reader strip UI: Play/Pause/Stop, voice dropdown, speed slider.

nodes.label: Agent C2 — Presenter View
nodes.rationale: Extend slideshow_ui.rs (~120 LoC): PresenterView with start_time, show_next_page, show_timer; presenter_window is a second viewport over already-rendered pages with an elapsed-time bar and next-page thumbnail.

nodes.label: Agent C3 — Open Quickly (⌘⇧O Launcher)
nodes.rationale: Extend home_ui.rs (~50 LoC): open_quickly_panel with a focused TextEdit, fuzzy subsequence_score over recents, top 12 results, center-top anchor like Spotlight.

nodes.label: Agent C4 — Create from Capture
nodes.rationale: New capture/screenshot.rs (~40 LoC): capture_region_interactive, capture_window, clipboard_as_png. Shell out to screencapture (-i, -l, -x) and osascript; reuse the existing image→PDF path. Create menu: From Screen Capture (⌘⇧S), From Window, From Clipboard.

nodes.label: Wave 3 — New Subsystems (4 Parallel Agents)
nodes.rationale: Independent of Waves 1–2, can start immediately. ~250 LoC, 4 gaps closed.

nodes.label: Cross-platform capture ceiling
nodes.rationale: ponytail ceiling: Windows use SnippingTool.exe /clip, Linux use flameshot gui -r — add #[cfg] branches later.

nodes.label: Cross-platform TTS ceiling
nodes.rationale: ponytail ceiling: Windows/Linux stubs return Err("Platform not supported"); add speech-dispatcher / SAPI later if cross-platform TTS is needed.

nodes.label: ID-card capture skipped
nodes.rationale: Same screencapture call, two regions — deliberately skipped because it is a mobile feature.

nodes.label: Open Quickly keybinding choice (⌘⇧O)
nodes.rationale: reference notes shows UPDF uses ⌘F for both Find and Open Quickly; pick ⌘⇧O and move on rather than emulating a bug.

nodes.label: Presenter view as second viewport over cached pages
nodes.norm_label: presenter view as second viewport over cached pages
nodes.rationale: slideshow_ui.rs and the render cache already exist — presenter view is a second viewport on pages already being rendered. Reuse the thumbnail renderer for the next-page preview rather than a full-res second page; timer = Instant::now() - start.

nodes.label: Shell out to macOS say for TTS
nodes.norm_label: shell out to macos say for tts
nodes.rationale: say is on every Mac, already has the voice catalogue and handles queueing; no objc2, no AVFoundation bindings, no new Cargo.toml dependency. One Option<Child> and ~30 LoC.

nodes.label: macOS screencapture shell-out for capture
nodes.rationale: screencapture is the macOS capture API — interactive crosshair (-i), window targeting (-l), screen selection. Reimplementing with CGDisplayCreateImage bindings would be weeks of work for a feature the OS ships as a binary.

nodes.label: Subsequence scoring for Open Quickly
nodes.rationale: No fuzzy-matcher dependency: a ~25-line subsequence matcher scores well for a recents list of ~50 entries that already fits in L1 cache. Score = matched run length, sort, take 12.

nodes.norm_label: wave 2 — ui integration (6 parallel agents, single file ownership)

nodes.label: Code sets as data table + regex pass
nodes.norm_label: code sets as data table + regex pass

nodes.label: No nested/compound redaction rules

nodes.label: Agent A2 — Page Resize, Interleaving, Page Exchange
nodes.norm_label: agent a2 — page resize, interleaving, page exchange
nodes.rationale: resize.rs + exchange.rs (~220 LoC): rewrite MediaBox, prepend scale matrix to content stream; interleave/exchange are pure index permutations building a new order Vec and calling reorder_pages.

nodes.label: Agent B2 — Page Resize & Exchange Dialog
nodes.norm_label: agent b2 — page resize & exchange dialog
nodes.rationale: Extend pages_ui.rs (~60 LoC): resize_page_dialog and interleave_exchange_buttons. Reuses the crop-margin 4-box UI shape with W×H fields; presets A4/Letter/Legal.

nodes.label: Agent D2 — Whole-PDF Bilingual Translation
nodes.rationale: Extend ai.rs, reuse office.rs text placement (~150 LoC): TranslationOptions and translate_pdf extract text runs, batch-translate one request per page, white-out originals and place translations shrink-to-fit with an optional bilingual line beneath.

nodes.label: Wave 4 — AI Gaps (2 Parallel Agents)
nodes.rationale: AI stack is isolated, independent of Wave 3. ~270 LoC, 7 gaps closed.

nodes.label: Annotation /Rect rescale ceiling
nodes.rationale: Annotations keep original /Rect in user-space; ponytail ceiling: rescale only if visual drift appears on extreme zoom.

nodes.label: Batched per-page translation
nodes.rationale: Send one batched request per page, not per run, to keep the quota sane; accept that the result is approximate and label it as such. Bilingual mode offsets the original below the translation by half the box height.

nodes.label: cm-prepend scale matrix trick
nodes.rationale: Prepend 'sx 0 0 sy tx ty cm' to the content stream scales text, vector, and images uniformly in one operator — no per-element rewriting, no XObject wrapping.

nodes.label: Interleave/exchange as index permutations
nodes.rationale: Build a new order Vec and call existing reorder_pages; interleave = pages.iter().step_by(2).zip(skip(1).step_by(2)).flatten().

nodes.label: Shrink-to-fit, no reflow
nodes.rationale: Reuse office.rs's w:framePr lesson rather than writing a layout engine: fit the translation into the original box by shrinking font size until it fits. Reflow is the trap that makes this a quarter-long project. ponytail ceiling: no reflow engine; complex multi-column/tables may overlap — add reflow if professional translation workflows need it.

nodes.label: AI writing tools as prompt strings
nodes.norm_label: ai writing tools as prompt strings
nodes.rationale: The writing tools are prompt strings, not code — the AiTask enum + dropdown plumbing is already built, so each tool is ~4 lines of prompt_template text.

nodes.label: NonConsecutive detector depends on Page Labels (A1)
nodes.norm_label: nonconsecutive detector depends on page labels (a1)
nodes.rationale: ponytail ceiling: the NonConsecutive PageDefect detector requires PageLabels from A1; its stub returns empty until A1 lands, so sequence D1 after A1.

nodes.label: Flat label segments (no prefix inheritance)
nodes.rationale: Skip UPDF's nested prefix inheritance UI; each page range gets one label, period. ponytail ceiling: add inheritance if complex legal docs need it.

nodes.label: /PageLabels sparse /Nums array
nodes.rationale: Sparse array shape /Nums [0 << /P (1-) /S /D >> 5 << /P (A-) /S /A >>]; the same dictionary-walking shape outline_gen.rs already uses, just a different key.

nodes.label: Roman/letter formatters (to_roman, to_letters)
nodes.rationale: Pure arithmetic conversion (1→I, 4→IV, 5→V, 9→IX; 1→A, 26→Z, 27→AA) — no dependencies, no PDF passes.

nodes.label: Agent A5 — Word Count & Document Stats
nodes.norm_label: agent a5 — word count & document stats
nodes.rationale: Extend search.rs SearchIndex (~30 LoC): word_count, cjk_count, space_count, plus DocumentStats UI convenience struct. One whitespace split over text already extracted — zero new PDF passes.

nodes.label: Agent A6 — Security Permissions Matrix
nodes.rationale: New protect/permissions.rs (~50 LoC): Permission enum, permissions_from_flags/flags_from_permissions, permission_label. A reader for data protect.rs already writes — pure decode, no policy.

nodes.label: Agent B5 — Properties Window Stats & Permissions
nodes.norm_label: agent b5 — properties window stats & permissions
nodes.rationale: Extend windows_ui.rs (~50 LoC): two CollapsingHeaders (Statistics, Security Permissions) with 2-column grids in the properties window that already exists — no new windows.

nodes.label: CJK Unicode ranges
nodes.rationale: CJK Unified Ideographs 4E00–9FFF, Hiragana 3040–309F, Katakana 30A0–30FF, Hangul Syllables AC00–D7AF.

nodes.label: Check Pages detectors mostly one-liners
nodes.rationale: 5 of 7 PageDefect detectors are one-liners over APIs that already exist (empty SearchIndex text, looks_scanned, MediaBox majority, annot count, majority rotation vote). Only non-consecutive needs thought.

nodes.label: /P permission flag decode
nodes.rationale: /P is a 32-bit integer with known bit positions (bits 3-12 permissions, bit 2 revision); one match, no bitflags dependency, pure decode with no policy. ponytail ceiling: no UI for rare CreateTemplatePages/HighQualityPrint.

nodes.label: Word/stats count over existing SearchIndex text
nodes.norm_label: word/stats count over existing searchindex text
nodes.rationale: SearchIndex::build already extracts every page's text and char_count() already exists, so word_count/cjk_count/space_count are a split over text already in hand — zero new PDF passes.

nodes.rationale: Caveat: detailed privacy-policy contents (GDPR rights, retention, third-party sharing) could not be extracted and verified; claims come from publisher communication, not an independent audit.

nodes.label: UPDF — cross-platform PDF editor
nodes.rationale: Positioned as a credible, much cheaper alternative to Adobe Acrobat with a strong focus on AI.

nodes.label: One-file-per-agent ownership rule
nodes.rationale: Avoid merge conflicts: each agent owns exactly one core/app file; toolbar_ui.rs and i18n.rs are frozen during a wave; report menu entries for the wave lead to wire in one commit.

nodes.label: i18n rule — write through t(), regenerate via i18n_extract.py
nodes.norm_label: i18n rule — write through t(), regenerate via i18n_extract.py
nodes.rationale: Never edit i18n.rs directly; extractor is append-only and runs once per wave; dynamic text uses format!() around translated fragments because the extractor regex won't match invented patterns.

nodes.label: Pixel measurement method — ImageMagick AE=0
nodes.rationale: egui's own font rasteriser vs Apple's SF Pro means text rasterisation will never bit-match; glyph-filled regions are a documented tolerance, so the target is identical layout and colour rather than a byte-equal image.
